label: Invoice was actually received on a date
description: Supersedes the recorded receipt date of one invoice; its payment deadline moves with it. Default: the Sparkline electrician invoice arrived Apr 15, not Mar 28.

label: Manager replies "paid"
description: Reply to a chase claiming payment, with no proof attached.

label: Vendor confirms it was paid
description: The vendor says it received the money.

label: Bank record shows the payment
description: The manager's bank records show an outgoing payment to the vendor.

label: Agreement payment window corrected
description: Corrects the vendor payment window (days) in the confirmed terms.

label: Vendor asks to change bank details
description: Held for identity verification and controller approval.
